summary: Target ep 59 (S3 part 1 ep 11, 'The Great Kaiju Battlefront' = ch 214's title) promoted to an exact record, and the batch-8 zone note needed a correction: the episode does not stop at 214 — it ends with the Titanic Infernal DESTROYED, which is ch 215's event (Kurono destroys it, 'Set Alight'), with Shō arriving at the ruins as the cliffhanger. ANN and CBR's episode reviews independently confirm the kaiju is put down at the episode's end, and CBR confirms Shinra is captured by Faerie within the episode. So ep 59 = 211-212 plus the Titanic Infernal thread of 213-215 (the Shō/Arrow-vs-Faerie pages interleaved in 213-215 are deferred), and ep 60 = the Faerie-duel thread of 213-215 plus 216 — the re-tread is a thread split, not a plain 213-214 repeat. Ep 60's stored END 216 is confirmed (per-episode tracker d0nut2x: ends at the end of ch 216; sportskeeda: part 1 = chs 175-216, continue at 217) — no repair needed, and a full ep-60 record is supplied.
